title: authenticator: match host when looking up git credentials
body:
This change avoids accidental leaks to a third party: For example, credentials are configured for https://github.com/org/project.git and a dependency points at a mirror, https://gitlab.com/org/project.git. The GitHub token is sent to GitLab.

The fixed bug should not be very interesting for potential attackers because they had to trick the user to configure a malicious git repository (or a malicious server), which already implies code execution.
